messages:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding sample app hit a weird parity issue. REST healthcheck /admin/health works but Node SDK throws 404 when I call client.admin.health().
prashant: hmm, which SDK version?
maya: v1.14.0 (node). Python sample app (sdk v1.14.0) calls the same and works.
jon: can you paste minimal repro?
maya: sure — REST that works:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/health
```
SDK that 404s:
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({token: process.env.T});
await c.admin.health(); // 404
```
emily: I think we never implemented admin.* passthrough in node — only certain admin routes are wired.
prashant: Ah yeah, there was a previous PR that added a curated subset. We meant to map everything but missed /admin/health.
maya: It’s a blocker for our onboarding script — we call health during CI. Any ETA on adding?
prashant: I'll open a patch, should be small. But also noticed something else: the SDK retry behavior for POST /routes/rollout differs. REST immediately returns 202 on our tests; SDK retries on 409 and re-sends causing duplicate rollouts.
jon: That's scary — double rollouts can change traffic. Is the 409 transient?
prashant: In our case it's a concurrent-mod race that should be handled by a single retry with backoff, not naive replay. The SDK's default retry config treats 409 as retryable in node but not in REST client-side code.
emily: We intentionally changed retry sets last quarter, but looks like SDK config drifted. We need a canonical retry table.
maya: Also ran into boolean flag mapping mismatch: REST accepts "force": true, but SDK sampleapp sends stringified 'true' when build with our sample CLI wrapper. So backend treats it as truthy in some endpoints and as string elsewhere.
jon: Where is the stringify happening? sample CLI or SDK?
maya: CLI wrapper. It reads env flags and does JSON.stringify on values before handing to SDK. Bad idea.
prashant: Ok action items: (1) add /admin/health wrapper to node SDK, (2) reconcile retry codepath — treat 409 as idempotent-only in rollout endpoints, (3) add validation to CLI wrapper to avoid stringifying booleans.
emily: I'll file a GH issue with test cases and add a small e2e to catch health endpoint parity.
prashant: I'll draft the SDK patch and include retry table changes, pinging @jon for rollout semantics review.
maya: thanks — can we have a temporary workaround note? CI can call REST directly until SDK patch lands.
prashant: yes, add a note in the sample app README.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued for branch sdk/admin-health-add (PR #421) — CI started. :rocket:
